title: Gate SDDC Manager host commissioning behind a precheck
prompt:
The Go module in this repository commissions ESXi hosts through the VMware Cloud Foundation 9.0 SDDC Manager REST API. Commissioning is gated behind a precheck: SDDC Manager prechecks the hosts first, and the hosts are commissioned only if that precheck succeeds.

`commission.Client.CommissionHosts` is a stub. Implement it.

The workflow uses the three operations `docs/contract.json` names:

1. `postHostsPrechecks_1` — `POST /v1/hosts/prechecks` submits the batch for prechecking and returns an execution id.
2. `getHostsPrechecksResponse` — `GET /v1/hosts/prechecks/{id}` reports `executionStatus`; read it until it reaches `COMPLETED`.
3. `commissionHosts` — `POST /v1/hosts` commissions the batch and returns a Task.

Step 3 must run only when the completed precheck `result` is `SUCCEEDED`. When the precheck fails, no request may reach `POST /v1/hosts` — a failed precheck has to leave the system untouched — and `CommissionHosts` must still return a `Result` describing what happened, together with an error wrapping `ErrPrecheckFailed`, with `HostErrors` carrying one entry per host that did not pass.

Requirements:

- Both request bodies carry `HostCommissionSpec` objects, but in different envelopes. `POST /v1/hosts/prechecks` takes an object with a `hosts` array; `POST /v1/hosts` takes a bare array. Get both exactly right.
- `HostCommissionSpec` has five required properties (`fqdn`, `username`, `password`, `storageType`, `networkPoolId`) and four optional ones (`vvolStorageProtocolType`, `networkPoolName`, `sshThumbprint`, `sslThumbprint`). An optional property the caller left unset must be absent from the serialized request, not sent as an empty string.
- `storageType` must be checked against the values this release accepts before anything is sent. A value this release does not accept has to be rejected with an error wrapping `ErrUnsupportedStorageType`, without issuing any request.
- Honour the context: a cancelled context must abort the wait without commissioning anything.
- `Result.Polls` counts the status reads performed, `Result.PrecheckID` and `Result.PrecheckResult` describe the precheck, and `Result.TaskID` is the id of the returned Task (empty unless the hosts were commissioned).

`docs/contract.json` is the authority for paths, methods, body shapes, success status codes and the accepted `storageType` values — read them from it rather than hard-coding a second copy. `docs/official_sources.json` records the specification revision that contract was derived from.

The `mockserver` package is a contract-pinned stand-in for SDDC Manager serving only those three operations. It uses loopback when sockets are available and an equivalent in-process HTTP transport in restricted sandboxes. It keeps a request log so tests can assert what actually went onto the wire; use it if you want to add tests of your own.

Do not modify `docs/`, `contract.go`, `mockserver/`, or `commission/wire_contract_test.go`.

`go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` must pass.

notes.deliverable: An implementation of commission.Client.CommissionHosts that satisfies the 9.0 wire contract and gates the mutating call behind the precheck.
notes.verification_is_offline: The protected tests drive the client against the contract-pinned mock over loopback when sockets are available and through an equivalent in-process HTTP transport otherwise. No VMware endpoint is contacted and the module has no external dependencies.
notes.contract_provenance: docs/contract.json and docs/official_sources.json are derived from specifications/sddc-manager/sddc-manager-openapi.json at tag 9.0.0.0 (commit 85151f6b1bb58f13b6ac0304bfec53904bea085f) of github.com/vmware/vcf-api-specs, Apache-2.0. TestContractProvenance pins the spec path, that commit sha, the three operationIds and the 9.0 storageType value set, so a contract taken from the 9.1.0.0 revision fails.
